statement: Make src/components/mobile/scan/ArrivalCard.test.ts pass. The component src/components/mobile/scan/ArrivalCard.tsx and its mount in src/components/mobile/redesign/UniversalScan.tsx already exist and are correct; do not change their behaviour. The test currently throws 'TypeError: Cannot set property navigator of #<Object> which has only a getter' because it installs jsdom globals with Object.assign(globalThis, {...}). Replace that setup with the exact pattern used by src/components/composer/composer-drill-menu.test.ts lines 15 to 56: create the JSDOM once, assign window, document, HTMLElement, Element, Node, MouseEvent and KeyboardEvent as individual properties on a `const g = globalThis as any`, install navigator with Object.defineProperty(globalThis, 'navigator', { value: dom.window.navigator, configurable: true }) instead of assignment, stub getBoundingClientRect the same way, and close the window in after(). Keep the three assertions: header text is the arrivalTitle string, exactly one button carries the primary variant, and its label is 'Unbox now' when pendingOrdersForCarton is 2. If a React act() warning appears, wrap render and clicks in act from 'react'. Touch only the test file unless a one-line prop rename in ArrivalCard.tsx is strictly required to mount.
